title: UE Landscape Authoring
description: Inspect, validate, snapshot, export, and safely apply deterministic Landscape and managed Water changes, including verified Water deletion recovery.

recipes.title: Audit and export one Landscape
recipes.description: Resolve one loaded Landscape, validate loaded structure, capture a semantic snapshot, and export deterministic raw recovery inputs.

inputs.name: landscape
inputs.description: Landscape GUID, path, name, or label.

inputs.name: weightLayer
inputs.description: Optional weight layer to export as r8.

steps.purpose: Resolve the exact Landscape and read material, extent, proxy, and layer evidence.
Check editability, full loaded extent, material, Layer Info assignments, and raw-import eligibility.
Export complete r16 height and optional r8 weight artifacts under Saved with sidecar hashes.

result.summary: A validated Landscape baseline with deterministic raw artifacts and bounded subsystem impact evidence.
evidence: Landscape identity and complete loaded extent
r16 and optional r8 artifact hashes
World Partition, Data Layer, HLOD, and PCG impact boundary
success: the selected Landscape was unambiguous and editable
each requested artifact was written with a sidecar hash
partial or unloaded coverage was reported rather than hidden

recipes.title: Plan, apply, verify, and optionally roll back a terrain change
recipes.description: Use one approved change plan for deterministic raster, material, Layer Info, and managed Water create, update, or delete operations.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: One to 32 admitted Landscape or Water operations.

inputs.name: rollbackAfterVerification
inputs.description: Restore the captured baseline after verification.

steps.purpose: Capture Landscape, optional Water, and partition-system evidence before proposing a write.
Plan the normalized request, approve its exact digest, and execute with confirmWrite and requestId.
Validate and compare the post-change semantic snapshot; inspect optional partition subsystems when available.
When requested, restore recovery artifacts in the same Editor instance and require the original semantic digest.

result.summary: One idempotent approved change with recovery artifacts, before/after evidence, and verified optional rollback.
evidence: normalized operation list and exact plan digest
source raster hashes and pre-change package hashes
verified Water actor export and identity evidence for each deletion
success: the exact current plan digest was approved
confirmWrite and a non-empty requestId were supplied
all operations completed in one Editor transaction
failure or explicit rollback restored the original semantic digest

resources.description: Raw raster format, approval, Water ownership, impact, and rollback boundaries.
